notes_zh:
- **新增** 快捷面板新样式「贴边条」：记录排成一行卡片贴在屏幕边缘，默认从底部滑出，会挡住正在输入的位置时从顶部出现。在「设置 → 快捷面板 → 显示 → 快捷面板样式」里切换
- **新增** 贴边条里按 ↑ 展开卡片的完整预览（从顶部出现时按 ↓）；卡片可以直接拖到别的 App
- **新增** 拆分：把一条记录拆成多条，在 ⌘K 菜单或右键里使用。可以按行、段落、编号、分隔符或正则拆，拆之前逐段预览，不要的段可以去掉；多个文件的记录拆成每个文件一条
- **新增** 合并、拆分、手动执行自动化规则、编辑保存之后，8 秒内可以撤销
- **新增** 内置自动化规则「转为纯文本」，去掉文字的格式
- **新增** 自动化规则条件「带格式」
- **优化** 多选粘贴按点选的先后顺序粘贴，列表里显示顺序号
- **优化** 「拆分并接力」并入「拆分」，在拆分页按 ⌘R 开启接力
- **优化** 删除后可以撤销的时间从 5 秒延长到 8 秒
- **修复** 快捷面板里右键「移入分组 → 新建分组」，弹窗被面板挡住、无法输入
- **修复** 快捷面板的「快捷操作」菜单（⌘K）点击菜单外面不会关闭
- **修复** 鼠标在「快捷操作」菜单上移动时菜单跟着滚动，中间的项很难点中
notes_en:
- **New** Edge Bar, a new Quick Panel style: your clips line up as cards along the screen edge. It slides up from the bottom, or appears at the top when the bottom would cover where you're typing. Switch it in Settings → Quick Paste → Display → Quick Panel Style
- **New** In the Edge Bar, press ↑ to preview a card in full (↓ when it's at the top), and drag cards straight into other apps
- **New** Split: turn one clip into several, from the ⌘K menu or right-click. Split by line, paragraph, number, delimiter or regex, preview every piece first and drop the ones you don't want; a clip of several files splits into one clip per file
- **New** Merging, splitting, running an automation rule by hand and saving an edit can be undone for 8 seconds
- **New** Built-in automation rule "Convert to plain text" removes the formatting from text
- **New** Automation rule condition "Has formatting"
- **Improve** Multi-select now pastes in the order you picked, with the order shown in the list
- **Improve** "Split and Relay" is now part of Split: press ⌘R on the split page to start Relay
- **Improve** A delete can now be undone for 8 seconds instead of 5
- **Fix** In the Quick Panel, the dialog from right-click → Assign to Group → New Group was hidden behind the panel and couldn't be typed into
- **Fix** The Quick Panel's Quick Actions menu (⌘K) didn't close when clicking outside it
- **Fix** The Quick Actions menu scrolled along with the pointer, making items in the middle hard to click
